usedFor: telecrm holds the leads and Template To builds the documents, so “New Lead Is Created” runs “Create PDF From Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Is Created” in telecrm, then “Create PDF From Template” in Template To
bestTemplate.why: The action fills your template and returns the PDF file URL for that lead.

watchOut: “Create PDF From Template” returns a link, not a delivered file, so sharing it with the lead is separate.
